meta.description: Progression of upper bounds on the matrix multiplication exponent omega, plus this repository's formalized ladder and conditional certificate tracks. The committed frontier record itself is NOT stored here: it is extracted from Frontier.lean into site/frontier.json at build time.

status_values.literature: Published result; NOT formalized in this repository. Number taken from the published literature.
status_values.formalized: FORMALIZED IN THIS REPO: machine-checked Lean theorem, axiom-audited to {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, over any field unless noted.
status_values.conditional_pending: IN THIS REPO but CONDITIONAL: the Lean implication is proved, but its hypotheses are named unproved Prop obligations. Not a valid record entry and not claimed as one.

meta.frontier_source_of_truth: Frontier.lean (repository root); the site reads it via site/frontier.json

records.citation: V. Strassen, Gaussian elimination is not optimal, Numer. Math. 13 (1969)
records.notes: R(2,2,2) <= 7 kernel-checked over any CommRing; omega <= log 7 / log 2 unconditional.

records.citation: V. Pan, Strassen's algorithm is not optimal, FOCS 1978
records.notes: Trilinear aggregation. Not formalized here (Pan-style aggregation is on the open backlog).

First border-rank record. This repo formalizes Bini's five-term approximate certificate and derives omega < 2.695 from it via Schoenhage's partial tau-theorem (bini_omega_lt, Examples/Bini.lean, any infinite field) — a related formalized bound, not the 2.7799 record itself.

records.citation: A. Schoenhage, Partial and total matrix multiplication, SIAM J. Comput. 1981
records.notes: Asymptotic sum inequality. The repo formalizes the inequality itself (asymptoticSumInequality) and Schoenhage's omega < 2.6 instance (schonhage_omega_lt_two_point_six, any field) plus the second-design omega < 2.695; the full 2.522 record is not claimed.

records.citation: V. Strassen, The asymptotic spectrum / laser method, FOCS 1986
records.notes: The laser method. The repo's laser machinery (hashing, zeroing, extraction) is formalized in reusable form, but this specific record value is not.

records.citation: D. Coppersmith, S. Winograd, Matrix multiplication via arithmetic progressions, J. Symbolic Comput. 1990
records.notes: The full CW tensor-square analysis, formalized end to end in this repo: unconditional over any field, exact integral reconstruction of the paper's rounded optimizer, ten-digit directed rational atanh arithmetic. This is the sharpest formalized bound in the tree. Weaker CW stages also formalized: easy variant omega < 2.41 (coppersmithWinograd_easy_omega_lt), first power omega < 2.3872 (coppersmithWinograd_firstPower_omega_lt). FRONTIER UPGRADE PENDING: at the time this data file was written the 2375477 modules were present in the working tree but not yet committed, and Frontier.lean deliberately cites the committed first-power bound 2.3872 until they land (see the 'Provenance of the inaugural record' section of Frontier.lean).

records.notes: The current published world record. Not formalized here.

CONDITIONAL. The implication is a proved Lean theorem, but it takes the named proof obligations of README's obligation table as explicit hypotheses (constituent type counting, compatibility zeroing and hole repair, exact level-four reconstruction). Conservative floors E >= 8.2, M_vol >= 6.0165; the stronger generated coarse floors give omega < 2.36985. If unconditional, this would beat the published record; it is not unconditional and is not claimed as a bound.

CONDITIONAL, and strictly further from closure than 2.36999: additionally needs the uniform quotient-feature count and a depth-four copywise fine-family composition. Floors E >= 8.2419803, M_vol >= 6.0091024. A sorted-pair diagnostic value 2.363141676 exists but is currently NOT admissible (quotient support not tight) and must not be displayed as a target.

formalized_ladder.notes: Closed integer-coefficient certificate R⟨2,2,2⟩ ≤ 7; the bound is the irrational log₂ 7, shown here rounded up.
Bini's five-term approximate 2×2 partial product certificate, formalized; the derived exponent bound, not the paper's 2.7799 record.
9^(ω/3) + 4^(ω/3) ≤ 10 from the ten-term degeneration; asymptotic sum inequality proved with no rank-additivity conjecture assumed.
One exact-rational atanh certificate, no floating point.

Fully formalized in the working tree: exact integral reconstruction of the paper's rounded optimizer, ten-digit directed rational atanh arithmetic. Not yet committed, so Frontier.lean does not cite it yet — the frontier upgrade is a documented three-line record PR.
